hook.text: You've lived 10,000 days. How many were for Allah?

end.text: You've lived 10,000 days. How many were for Allah?
end.gold: Tonight, at Isha: give Him day 10,001.

captions: School. Work. Weddings. A thousand plans.
“Later,” you told Him. “When things calm down.”
They never calmed down. The days kept going.
Tonight, you walk in for Isha. Day 10,001.
The rows. The quiet. Your forehead on the floor.
Not a perfect life. Just a first honest day.

post.caption:
You've lived 10,000 days. How many were for Allah? 🌙

27 years. School, work, weddings, a thousand plans. “Later,” you told Him. Things never calmed down.

“Every soul will taste death.” (3:185)

It's not too late. Tonight, at Isha: give Him day 10,001. 🤍
